Field.Name: Order Reference Number

Field.Name: Depth Side

Field.Name: Depth Order Capacity

Field.Description: The total quantity of the new order being added to the book

Message.Name: Single Side Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a Side order is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the Strategy, as defined in the Complex Strategy Message.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: Executed volume
Field.Description: The total quantity executed

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition is the same as defined in the OPRA specification.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an incoming Side order is executed against the book in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the Strategy, as defined in the Complex Strategy Message.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Not applicable for complex, will be conveyed as space " "

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution quantity.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition is the same as defined in the OPRA specification.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Auction Message
Message.Description: This message is used to announce strategy auctions. The start of auction is announced, followed by possible updates on the auction, and announcing the end of the auction.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the Strategy, as defined in the Complex Strategy Message.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of Auction

Field.Name: Auction Duration
Field.Description: User defined for Auction Duration. In milliseconds between 3,000 and 300,000

Field.Name: Auction Event
Field.Description: Auction Event

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: Order Type

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Size

Field.Name: Exec Flag
Field.Description: Exec Flag

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Indicates the order capacity

Field.Name: Scope
Field.Description: Scope

Field.Name: Owner ID
Field.Description: Attributable Order may provide Firm ID to disseminate with order; Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Giveup
Field.Description: Attributable Order may provide Give-up to disseminate with order; Spaces when not set

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Attributable Order may provide CMTA to disseminate with order; Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Response Price
Field.Description: Price of the aggregated auction responses in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Response Size
Field.Description: Size of the aggregated auction responses at the best price (zero if not shown).

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Number of Flex DAC Legs
Field.Description: Number of Flex DAC legs in the strategy Legs

Field.Name: Flex DAC Leg Information
Field.Description: Flex DAC Leg Information
